description: Config discovery walks to filesystem root: a ~/.todo-db/config.json or ~/Developer ancestor config hijacks every unscaffolded repo beneath it, and a malformed ancestor config bricks descendants. Stop at HOME or the git toplevel. Separately the generated wrapper hardcodes ../.. for REPO_ROOT regardless of --wrapper PATH depth.

work_units.evidence: Bounded discovery stops at git root and home; wrapper REPO_ROOT derived from path depth
work_units.summary: Discovery ceiling + wrapper REPO_ROOT derivation + tests
